title: Route an ordinary documentation request without inventing an ADR
prompt: Add a short setup section to a README using the supplied verified commands. No architecture decision, policy change, or material engineering choice is involved.
expected_behaviors: Use the lightweight documentation path and update only the relevant README section.
Verify commands against current source or scripts.
Report the changed path and verification performed.
must_not: Do not create an unnecessary architecture decision record.
Do not broaden the request into an architecture review.
